*Hold the merge — one critical finding.*

*CRITICAL — Sessions expire after 30 milliseconds, not 30 minutes* (`src/idle.js:1–4`).
`lastSeen` and `now` are millisecond timestamps, but `IDLE_TIMEOUT` is `30`. I reproduced a session becoming idle after just **31 ms**, and `sweep()` removing it (`src/sweep.js:6`).
*Recommended fix:* use `30 * 60 * 1000` and an inclusive comparison (`now - session.lastSeen >= IDLE_TIMEOUT`) to expire at exactly 30 minutes.

*Coverage gap:* All 4 tests pass, but `test/idle.test.js` only checks immediately after activity and after an hour; `test/sweep.test.js` checks fresh versus two-hour-old sessions. Add cases just before, at, and just after 30 minutes, plus a recently active session surviving a sweep.

Reviewed the full branch diff against `main`. No code edits made.
